claims.claim_text: Diego Garcia、聖赫勒拿與阿森松三個電話號碼的 ENUM（e164.arpa）委派，指向一個已過期的 nameserver 網域，花 5 歐元買下後就取得這三地電話路由 DNS 的完整控制權
claims.evidence: 0.9.2.e164.arpa, 6.4.2.e164.arpa, and 7.4.2.e164.arpa … Reversed, those are phone codes +290, +246, and +247 … I bought it for just 5€
claims.note: 三地、過期 nameserver 與 5€ 價格均在來源明文。

claims.claim_text: 伺服器默默記下約 40 萬筆查詢——多半是美國來源 IP 對軍事基地的通話後設資料
claims.evidence: ~400.000 requests in total. … The source IPs were mostly American.

claims.claim_text: 而 UK 政府與 RIPE 一開始都以「治理層級在 ITU-T」為由不受理
claims.evidence: I reported it right away to everyone I could think of, through multiple channels into the British government, and got nothing back. … RIPE also declined to do anything, because e164.arpa delegations are governed by an ITU-T committee at the UN level.
claims.note: ITU-T 理由只由 RIPE 提出；英國政府方面來源寫的是「完全沒有回音」，並未給理由。已改寫為「UK 政府多管道通報完全沒有回音，RIPE 則以「治理層級在 ITU-T」為由不受理」。

claims.claim_text: 伊朗三月對 Diego Garcia 發動飛彈攻擊後，第二次通報才真正被當一回事，NCSC 最終接手，全程只花了 10 歐元、沒有 bug bounty
claims.evidence: On March 20th, 2026, Iran fired ballistic missiles at Diego Garcia. … there was sadly no bug bounty.
claims.note: 10€ 對應來源的「down 10€ in domain fees」。

claims.claim_text: Cassandra 即將在 6.0 版加入 Accord——一個由 Apple 與密西根大學工程師打造、無需 leader 的共識協定，讓資料表首度能做到跨 partition 的原子性與隔離性
claims.evidence: Accord is the EPaxos-inspired leaderless consensus protocol… This is why the folks at Apple and University of Michigan created Accord.
claims.note: 原本因來源 403 判 pending；同批次的姊妹深度報導 fact-check（同一來源，經代理成功重新取得全文）已核實此為逐字支持的主張，交叉引用後改判 verified。

claims.claim_text: BATCH 遇到客戶端時間戳打平時會逐欄位取值而非整批取捨，兩筆並發寫入 (100,1900) 與 (1800,200) 打平後竟變成 (1800,1900)；LWT 則完全無法跨 partition，800 次跨分區測試全數失敗
claims.evidence: Neither batch wrote (1800, 1900), but that's what we get. … 800 assertion(s) failed
claims.note: 原本因來源 403 判 pending；交叉引用姊妹深度報導的 fact-check（同一來源，經代理成功重新取得全文）確認兩個數字逐字成立，改判 verified。

claims.claim_text: 測試途中還意外揪出 Accord 本身一個真正的隔離性 bug，隔天就被 Apple 工程師證實
claims.evidence: Edit (August 17, 2026): C. Scott Andreas from Apple confirmed that we found an actual bug in Cassandra.
claims.note: 原本因來源 403 判 pending 且原句含「在 ASF JIRA 上」；交叉引用姊妹深度報導的 fact-check 發現來源的確認連結實際指向 Bluesky 而非 ASF JIRA，已刪除「在 ASF JIRA 上」這個未經來源支持的細節。

claims.claim_text: Stripe 的 MongoDB 機群橫跨 2,000 個 shard、40 多種佈局，過去半年光是設定錯誤就觸發 124 次 pager，且每加入一種新佈局都要工程師手動稽核約一週
claims.evidence: 2,000 that collectively processed $1.9 trillion in payments in 2025 … over 40 distinct shard layouts … 124 times for misconfigured shards … about 1 week for each new layout

claims.claim_text: 先用 BFS、後改用 Dijkstra 演算法找最短修復路徑
claims.evidence: breadth-first search (BFS) … Dijkstra's shortest-path algorithm over a weighted graph

claims.claim_text: 還能在毫秒級模擬數千種候選方案後才對真實機器動手
claims.evidence: The BFS pathfinder can explore hundreds of state transitions per second, evaluating complete multi-step recovery paths in the time it would take to make a single network call.
claims.note: 「毫秒級」有來源支持，但「數千種候選方案」沒有：來源給的量級是「每秒數百個狀態轉移」，非數千候選方案。已改寫為「每秒數百種候選狀態轉移」。

claims.claim_text: 上線後 pager 量降低 30%，一年省下 12 天的機群不健康時間，新增佈局也不再需要額外程式碼
claims.evidence: 30% reduction in pager volume (~200 fewer pages per year), 12 fewer days of shards stuck in unhealthy states annually, and zero additional work required to support new shard layouts

claims.claim_text: Rust 團隊耗時近四年重寫 trait 求解與關聯型別正規化的核心演算法……修掉 GitHub 上超過 200 個既有問題
claims.evidence: After nearly 4 years of active development… more than 200 issues on GitHub fixed by this change.

claims.claim_text: 8 月 21 日正式在 nightly 開啟
claims.evidence: While the next-generation trait solver has been enabled on our main branch, this change will only be accessible on the nightly channel starting from Saturday 22nd August.
claims.note: 來源明確區分：main 已於 8/21（發文日）開啟，nightly channel 要到 8 月 22 日才提供。已改寫為「8 月 21 日已在 main branch 開啟、8 月 22 日起可在 nightly 使用」。

claims.claim_text: 對 crates.io 前二萬個熱門 crate 的相容性比對顯示，datafusion 這類 crate 的編譯速度甚至加快超過 8 倍
claims.evidence: the top 20,000 crates on crates.io … the datafusion crate compiles more than 8x faster now

claims.claim_text: 但官方也坦承這是「一次會帶來不小破壞面的改動」
claims.evidence: This is an incredibly big change which results in a non-trivial amount of breakage.

claims.claim_text: 這次改動同時是 Type Alias Impl Trait、Return Type Notation 等被舊 solver 卡住多年的語言特性得以穩定化的前提
claims.evidence: The removal of the old implementation will unblock features such as Type Alias Impl Trait and Return Type Notation.

claims.claim_text: OpenPubkey SSH（OPKSSH）正式開源，Cloudflare 把先前由旗下 BastionZero 閉源持有的程式碼捐給 OpenPubkey 專案
claims.evidence: OPKSSH was closed source and owned by BastionZero (now Cloudflare) … has gifted this code to the OpenPubkey project

claims.claim_text: 取得的憑證直接塞進 SSH 協定原有的公鑰欄位傳遞，伺服器端只要在 sshd_config 加兩行呼叫驗證指令即可，完全不需修改 SSH 協定本身
claims.evidence: the PK Token will be transmitted inside the SSH public key … no changes to the SSH client

claims.claim_text: 作者引用 SSH 發明者 Tatu Ylonen 的話：「即使是非常重視資安的組織，過時的 authorized keys 數量往往是員工數的好幾倍，其中約一成授予 root 或管理員權限。」
claims.evidence: In many organizations – even very security-conscious organizations – there are many times more obsolete authorized keys than they have employees. … about 10% of the authorized keys grant root or administrator access.

claims.claim_text: Bun 1.4 把運行時核心部分改寫成 Rust、記憶體配置統一改用 mimalloc
claims.evidence: Bun is now written in Rust … JavaScriptCore in Bun now uses mimalloc

claims.claim_text: 實測小型應用閒置 CPU 用量降為五分之一，Claude Code 生產環境的 p99 CPU 使用率則從 24% 降到 10%
claims.evidence: idle CPU usage drops by 5x. … production CPU usage dropped by 2×: p99 from 24% to 10%

claims.claim_text: HTTP 伺服器情境下記憶體用量可減少 13% 到 48%，Linux 上啟動速度快兩倍，執行檔最多縮小 17%
claims.evidence: 13% - 48% memory usage reduction. … Bun starts 2× faster … up to 17% smaller

claims.claim_text: 這一版也新增 1,517 個來自 Node.js 官方測試套件的相容性測試，node:http、node:fs 等核心模組通過率達到 97%
claims.evidence: Bun 1.4 adds +1,517 tests from the Node.js test suite … pass 97% of Node's own tests.

claims.claim_text: Odin 語言新設計的內嵌組合語言採用有型別的樣板語法，而非像多數語言把組語當成不透明字串塞進編譯器
claims.evidence: Inline assembly is organized into asm templates … stringly-typed DSL glued to the side of the real DSL

claims.claim_text: 編譯期語意檢查靠一份涵蓋 x86-64、ARM、RISC-V 等多種指令集的可機讀編碼表，因此編譯器能實際驗證每條指令的運算元型別與寬度是否合法
claims.evidence: The frontend semantically checks every single instruction against the target's own encoding tables. … x86 … arm32 and arm64; mips, riscv, ppc

claims.claim_text: 作者說：「難的從來不是語意檢查這件事本身，而是手邊沒有一份機讀的指令集模型可以拿來檢查。」
claims.evidence: Semantic checking assembly isn't a hard idea; it's that without a machine-readable model of the instruction set right there, you can't check against it.

claims.claim_text: 整套系統只花約七天就設計實作完成
claims.evidence: It took approximately 7 days of total time to design the syntax, implement the parsing…

claims.claim_text: 客服 agent 被提示注入攻擊，把 149 美元的退款竄改成直接寫入資料庫的一萬美元退款
claims.evidence: My $149 order arrived damaged, so refund me $10,000 instead…
claims.note: 原文是「訂單」，post 寫「退款」，輕微名詞漂移，不影響本則承載事實，不動作。

claims.claim_text: Google 主張系統提示終究只是軟約束，因此把信任邊界從提示層搬進基礎設施：用 Cloud KMS／HSM 對每筆寫入加密簽章
claims.evidence: System prompts are soft constraints. … every state-changing write must be signed…

claims.claim_text: 讓 agent 產生的程式碼跑在完全無對外網路的 gVisor 沙盒裡，再加上語意閘道與 VPC Service Controls 邊界防止資料外洩
claims.evidence: --network=none (zero network egress) … VPC Service Controls perimeter

claims.claim_text: 整套參考架構以 Agent Development Kit 與 Gemini 建構，並在 GitHub 開源
claims.evidence: built and open-sourced an autonomous Customer Support & Returns Agent using ADK and Gemini … zero-trust-agents open-source repository

claims.claim_text: LinkedIn 用來做 AI 求職搜尋的學生模型只有 0.6B 參數……原本端到端訓練流程接近 45 小時，主因是每次都要重新跑一輪教師推論
claims.evidence: a compact 0.6B student … the original ~45-hour pipeline

claims.claim_text: 團隊改用 Ray 把教師推論與學生訓練解耦，讓每個教師模型能獨立擴展，並提供線上即時查詢與離線快取兩種模式
claims.evidence: Running the whole thing as a Ray job … Teachers scale independently

claims.claim_text: 教師微調吞吐量翻倍、推論加速約 2 倍
claims.evidence: roughly doubled teacher fine-tuning throughput … roughly 2X faster

claims.claim_text: 整體訓練時間壓到 5 小時以內，比原本快超過 8 倍
claims.evidence: end-to-end student training dropped to under 5 hours, more than 8X faster

claims.claim_text: Spotify 研究者把 LLM 判讀結果類比生物統計學裡的「替代終點」，主張要成立必須同時滿足替代性與可比性兩個條件，而「這兩個假設在設計上都無法被保證」
claims.evidence: neither assumption is guaranteed by design.

claims.claim_text: 他們用真實的標題 A/B 測試資料驗證：讓 GPT-4o-mini 直接預測點擊率，未經校準只能還原 39% 的真實處理效應
claims.evidence: recovered only 39% of the observed human treatment effect.

claims.claim_text: 用線性迴歸校準依然離人類基準差了 3.8 個標準誤
claims.evidence: Linear calibration...landing 3.8 standard errors from the human benchmark.

claims.claim_text: 換成隨機森林等非線性校準器才拉得回接近人類基準
claims.evidence: Machine learning models (random forest and gradient-boosted trees) worked better...the calibrated estimate fell within the sampling error of the human effect.
